facts.text: Master creates a rospy.Publisher on the absolute /crazyflie/cmd_vel topic with geometry_msgs/Twist and queue size 1.
Master creates a rospy.Publisher on the absolute /crazyflie/trajectory_packet topic with crazyflie_trajectory/TrajectoryPacket and queue size 100.
Master creates a rospy.Publisher on the absolute /crazyflie/synchronization_packet topic with crazyflie_trajectory/SynchronizationPacket and queue size 100.
Master creates a rospy.ServiceProxy on the absolute /crazyflie/update_params service with crazyflie_trajectory/UpdateParams.
Master creates a rospy.ServiceProxy on the absolute /crazyflie/emergency service with std_srvs/Empty.
The transfer loop sends every packet in data['packets'] twenty times, sleeping 5 ms between publications.
synchronize_trajectory copies circular and number from the trajectory and fills all four SynchronizationPacket time slots with the same float start delay.
The master help text identifies 'q' as 'Calls emergency service' and 't' as 'Transfer a trajectory file to the UAV'.
TrajectoryPacket declares float32[6] data, float32 time and the uint8 fields index, dimension, number and type.
SynchronizationPacket declares uint8 synchronize, uint8[4] circular, uint8[4] number and float32[4] time.
UpdateParams has a string[] params request and an empty response.
Converter subscribes to the absolute /crazyflie/log_ref topic with crazyflie_trajectory/GenericLogData
Trajectory sets nDim to 4 and timeStep to 0.02, evaluating at 50 Hz as in the firmware.

trajectoryExample.launch defaults the uri argument to radio://0/35/2M, includes the external crazyflie_driver crazyflie_server.launch and starts crazyflie_add with that uri in the crazyflie namespace.

trajectoryExample.launch configures crazyflie_add with the generic log topics log_ref, log_pos, log_errors and log_cacheB at 10 each, log_ref carrying the reference x, y, z, roll, pitch and yaw variables.
trajectoryExample.launch starts the master node of crazyflie_trajectory.
The README lists a Crazyflie driver modified from the original for communicating with the crazyflie and a Crazyflie firmware modified to support SE(3) control as dependencies.
The master command loop calls the emergency service proxy for the q keyword.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned acknowledgements with no quadrotor dynamics, controller, trajectory replay or wall-clock pacing; every state value is a placeholder

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free contract fake for the trajectory publication and service contract (no physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free contract transport: it runs no crazyflie_ros node, controller, Simulink model, Gazebo world or UAV
the upstream transfer loop sends every packet twenty times with a 5 ms sleep; the fake reproduces neither the repetition nor the pacing
one action publishes one ROS message; it does not upload a complete trajectory or guarantee that the external driver consumes the packet sequence

the /crazyflie/emergency callback implementation is in the external crazyflie_ros repository, not in this clone; the fake acknowledgement is not a stop proof, and no stop is bound (blocked NO_HARDWARE_FREE_PATH)

every bound topic and service is an input of the external crazyflie_ros driver that the clone's launch files start with a Crazyradio URI for a real Crazyflie; the clone has no ROS simulator, so mode simulated (from the registry record) does not describe the ROS route
master.py creates the /crazyflie/cmd_vel publisher but never publishes on it, so the clone states no meaning or unit for the Twist fields; the external driver decides what they command

the external driver publishes /crazyflie/log_ref with its own GenericLogData type; this package declares crazyflie_trajectory/GenericLogData from the clone's converter, and whether rosbridge accepts that type name for the live topic is unverified
the fake copies the six trajectory-packet coefficients into a placeholder /crazyflie/log_ref state so the resource changes; that is not dynamics, a measured pose or a reference-pose model
the clone's /crazyflie/log_pos observation and the converter's file output are NOT COVERED
no live ROS graph, rosbridge peer, launch file, simulator or hardware was run

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop exists: the e-stop fails MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held, which only refuses this driver's commands; /crazyflie/emergency is answered by the external crazyflie_ros driver (the clone defines only the proxy), so nothing shows what the Crazyflie is left in, and an uploaded trajectory or the last command stays with the external driver and firmware.
